The Challenge Submitting a complex doctoral grant application under a tight deadline Submitting a complex doctoral grant application under a tight deadline Submitting a complex doctoral grant application under a tight deadline Submitting a complex doctoral grant application under a tight deadline Super Bock's R&D and innovation department operates without a dedicated team or external partner focused on their grant processes, meaning relevant funding opportunities can go unnoticed or simply not be delivered on time . That was nearly the case with the Concurso Bolsas de Doutoramento 2026 – Linha de Candidatura Geral (FCT Doctoral Scholarships Competition). When the team identified this call and the candidate was mutually agreed upon with the Academic Institution, they had a very tight deadline to meet: submissions closed on March 31st . Starting from scratch on an application that demanded scientific rigour, precise academic language, and properly formatted bibliographic references, and still deliver a complete, high-quality proposal on time, would have been virtually impossible to do manually and without support .
